submission.justification: S2 has the highest stat-only significance (4.1 sigma), but its background estimate fails the validation-region check: 35% data/MC disagreement against the agreed 10% tolerance, because its jet-substructure inputs are poorly modelled. So its background estimate is not robust. Of the strategies that pass, S3 (6% disagreement) has a higher expected significance than S1 (3%): 3.4 sigma vs 2.6 sigma at 50% signal efficiency. Caveats: no Monte Carlo sensitivity tool was available, so these numbers come from the 2025 stat-only summary and no working-point scan was done. 50% is inside the 20-80% window, but it was not optimised. Adding the background systematic will lower the 3.4 sigma figure.

requirements.evidence: S3 has the highest significance (3.4 sigma stat-only at 50% eff) among strategies with a robust background. S2 is higher at 4.1 sigma but fails robustness. The working point was not optimised and systematics are not included.

requirements.requirement: Selection is one of the three candidate strategies

requirements.evidence: S3 validation-region disagreement is 6%, within the 10% tolerance

requirements.requirement: Submit one strategy and working point
